decision.section: Iterate - feature: brand from a claude.ai Design System for the design phase
decision.title: A brand comes from the user's claude.ai Design System, not from a token file in the plugin
decision.context: The operator keeps their brand (svenroth.ai) in a Design System on claude.ai and wanted the design phase to use it. A brand-specific token set in the plugin would impose one person's brand on every user of the framework.
decision.decision: Design Step 2.5 and Step 3 offer a claude.ai Design System as brand source. brand-from-design-system.md lists the artifacts, reads tokens.json, maps it to the kit contract and lays the result over warm, clean or bold. scripts/tools/check_brand_tokens.py checks the contract rules (the same pairs the tests use) and prints the nearest passing colour for each weak pair; Claude applies the fixes and tells the user what changed.
decision.consequences: The Design System stays the single source of truth and nothing brand-specific ships in the plugin. Brand colours that fail the readability rules are corrected and reported, never silently kept. The mapping itself remains Claude's judgement; only the check and the fixes are deterministic.
decision.rationale: Names in a Design System do not match the contract one to one, so the mapping needs judgement, while the contrast arithmetic is exact and belongs in a tested tool that the shipped sets share.
decision.rejected: A shipped svenroth token set (imposes one brand, one more set to build and test); a default token set (changes the skill's behaviour for everyone); prose-only contrast checks (can miss pairs and cannot be tested).

changelog.bullet: Design: take the brand from a Design System on claude.ai (Step 2.5 and the Step 3 brand question); the colours are mapped to the Untitled UI kit contract, checked for readability and corrected where they fail
Design: check_brand_tokens.py checks a brand override against the kit's contrast, solid-hex and font-size rules and suggests the nearest passing colour for each weak pair
Spec: FR-01.04 gains AC13, the look and feel can come from the operator's Design System on claude.ai

behaviors.behavior: weak brand colours laid over a shipped set are flagged with a nearest passing colour, and applying the most contrasting suggestions brings every contract rule to green
a value the checker cannot read (rgb(), 8-digit hex, non-px size) is reported, a 3-digit hex is read as the colour it means, so an override is never skipped and green on the base
CLI exit codes: 0 when every rule holds, 1 with failures and suggestions, 2 for a missing file, usage error without arguments; also run in-process for diff coverage
a missing token, a missing or too small font size and a primary-hover that is not darker than primary are reported
the shipped sets warm, clean and bold still meet every contrast rule, now evaluated by the same checker
the claude.ai Design System route is reachable from SKILL.md, Step 2.5, the Step 3 question and the kit doc, and the checker the procedure names exists
Claude lists the user's Design System artifacts, reads tokens.json and maps it to the contract following the procedure
behaviors.reason: depends on the live claude.ai Artifact service and on Claude's own mapping judgement; the deterministic half (contract check and fixes) is tested above

finalize.reason: iterate: brand from a claude.ai Design System for the design phase
